dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible light-toned 'O' and 'C' shaped rings exhibit high-frequency, irregular outer perimeters with sharp luminance transitions (approx. 2-5 pixel gradient) from dark-charcoal base to light-grey rings. Several closed annuli in the upper-mid region show distinct dark cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters lacking internal gradients. These clusters are distributed asymmetrically, primarily in the interstices between larger annular structures, notably in the mid-lower-right sector.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal-aligned annuli form an irregular obtuse triangle. A larger, secondary polygonal relationship is formed by connecting the centroids of the central closed annulus with four adjacent partial 'C' structures.
